call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: FY2027 CapEx Acceleration & GenAI Monetization Horizon
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Mark, you indicated that CapEx will grow significantly in 2027. Can you help investors understand the return on invested capital equation? How much of this compute is improving core ad recommendation today versus speculative frontier model training?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_response: CEO Mark Zuckerberg stressed that the vast majority of AI infrastructure deployed today delivers immediate, measurable ROI. Core AI recommendation models drove an 8% increase in Instagram engagement and directly powered the +11% ad pricing realization in Q3. The frontier investments in Muse and Muse Wonder represent the platform for personal superintelligence, which will transform Meta into an interactive cognitive layer across commerce, messaging, and smart glasses.

call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: Reality Labs Losses vs. Orion AR Commercialization Roadmap
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Reality Labs posted another $4.4B operating loss this quarter. Following the impressive Orion prototype unveil, what is the path toward commercializing consumer holographic glasses while keeping annual operating losses from expanding uncontrollably?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_response: Mark Zuckerberg reiterated that Orion represents the holy grail of mobile computing—combining a wide field of view, neural wristband interface, and lightweight form factor. While commercial production volume is several years away, Orion's custom silicon and display breakthroughs will cascade into near-term Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses, where sales doubled YoY with significant retail backlog.
